# Huy Le — Software Engineer

> Le Tran Gia Huy (Huy Le) is a frontend engineer with 4+ years building
> production-grade web platforms in React, Next.js (App Router, RSC, Streaming),
> and TypeScript across healthcare, legal-tech, and enterprise-event domains.
> Technical lead and primary developer on core Naver Care tools, focused on
> scalable monorepo architecture, design-system standardization, and AI-native /
> LLM-assisted product features. Based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

This is Huy Le's personal portfolio — a single-page site at https://huyle.blog.
Its sections are in-page anchors (not separate URLs): an intro/hero, an about
section, a mission statement, an "Off the clock" photo gallery (an interactive
WebGL globe), capabilities, experience, selected work, and contact.

## Site

- [Portfolio home](https://huyle.blog): Hero, About, Capabilities ("What I Do"), Experience, selected Work, the "Off the clock" gallery, and Contact — all on one page.
